memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "If he selects her for his son, he must grant her the rights of a daughter. If he marries another woman, he must not deprive the first one of her food, clothing and marital rights. If he does not provide her with these three things, she is to go free, without any payment of money." - Exodus 21:9-11 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God keeps building a wall of protection around this vulnerable woman. If she is given to a son, she must be treated as a full daughter, not a slave. If the man takes another wife, her food, clothing, and marital rights cannot be cut off. And if he fails in these basic duties, she goes free, owing nothing. God ties obligations onto the powerful and grants an escape to the weak.

Notice how detailed God's care is. He names food, clothing, and marital rights — the practical necessities of life and love. Our God is not distant or vague about human needs. He notices whether people are fed, covered, and cherished. What some cultures treated as throwaway, God treated as sacred.

This same attentive care surrounds you. Jesus reminded us that the Father knows we need food and clothing and provides for us (Matt 6:31-32). The God who legislated protection for a forgotten woman thousands of years ago has not grown careless. He sees your needs today, and He calls His people to guard the dignity and provision of those who depend on them.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Am I faithful in the practical duties I owe to those who depend on me?
Do I trust that God notices and cares about my daily needs?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You care about food, shelter, and love — the real needs of real people. Make me faithful in my duties and help me rest in Your provision for mine. Amen.
